prediction.raw: I would say 1, YTA (You're The Asshole) in this scenario. As a parent, it's natural to want to stay connected with your child, especially when they're away at university. However, it's essential to respect their boundaries and independence. By showing up unannounced, you may have overstepped those boundaries and invaded your son's personal space. Your son had been ignoring your calls or not answering, which could be a sign that he needs space or time to focus on his studies and personal life. Instead of respecting his wishes, you decided to visit him without warning, which might have caught him off guard and made him feel uncomfortable. Additionally, your comments about the apartment's cleanliness, although possibly well-intentioned, might have come across as judgmental or critical. This could have contributed to your son's annoyance and defensiveness. It's understandable that you're concerned about your son's well-being, but it's crucial to find a balance between being supportive and respecting his independence. In the future, it might be better to have an open and honest conversation with your son about your concerns and boundaries, rather than showing up unannounced. It's also worth considering that your son is 19 and in university, which means he's likely trying to establish his own identity and independence. Giving him space and respecting his boundaries can help him develop a sense of autonomy and responsibility, which is an essential part of growing up.
